gamut.note: dE76 measured on the sRGB->CMYK->sRGB round trip through the press profile, computed in exact CIE Lab (D65). A relative colorimetric round trip carries a ~4-5 dE floor even for in-gamut neutrals because the source white/black points map onto the medium's; the tolerance is set above that floor so only genuine gamut failures (10-60 dE) are reported.
